title: Commission Referee Testing of Metering Service Meters: Fees and Request Window
content:
After a company accuracy test, a **Metering Service** customer who disputes the result may ask for a Commission referee test wherever the meter type allows it. The fee the customer pays for a referee test is refunded if the referee finds the meter outside tolerance.

| Meter type | Referee test available | Referee test fee (USD) | Calendar days after the company test date within which a referee test may be requested |
|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Communicating Opt-Out Meter | Yes | 25.00 | 30 |
| Standard AMI Smart Meter | Yes | 25.00 | 30 |
| AMI Bidirectional Net Meter | Yes | 25.00 | 30 |
| AMI Three-Phase Commercial Meter | Yes | 50.00 | 30 |
| AMI Interval Demand Meter | Yes | 50.00 | 30 |
| Primary Metering Installation | Yes | 100.00 | 30 |

## Points of reference

- Every meter type allows a referee test, and every type has the same 30-day request window.
- The fee differs by type: 25.00 for the three residential-class types, 50.00 for the AMI Three-Phase Commercial Meter and the AMI Interval Demand Meter, and 100.00 for the Primary Metering Installation.
- **Fee outcome (hypothetical results).** A customer with an AMI Three-Phase Commercial Meter pays the 50.00 referee fee. If the referee finds the meter outside tolerance, the 50.00 is refunded; if the referee finds it within tolerance, the fee stays paid.
